PASS on the fake backend; gate.digest is the digest line printed by the last gate run (G1-G7 and G9 pass, G8 warns only G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE). Served device mhs://localhost/robosuite-door-open, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the floors of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The card's first entry symbol was verified at robosuite/environments/door_open.py:19. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes the MujocoDriver family helper, but DoorOpen is a robosuite environment, not one MJCF scene: it builds a TableArena, DoorObject, robot and DoorTask at construction (door_open.py:131-142) and serves reset()/step(action)/close() (base.py:137-142, :180-201, :344), while MujocoDriver serves one model through model_path/mj_step. The package is a direct Driver over robosuite.environments.door_open:DoorOpen with the package fake .fake:FakeDoorOpen, and still binds cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1. Only DoorOpen is served; Lift, NutAssemblySingle, NutAssemblySquare and NutAssemblyRound are NOT COVERED. The fake is a physics-free F0 stand-in (no MuJoCo world, robot, controller, table, door, contact, camera or noise); its numbers are placeholders marked in fake.py and it reports done false and reward 0.0. NOT COVERED: the real observation arrays, including the agentview camera image (the camera observation default is 256x256, door_open.py:47-48) and every other camera image and depth map (robot_env.py:247-273); the fake returns a small placeholder dictionary with robot0_eef_pos, robot0_eef_quat, robot0_gripper_qpos, task_state and target_pos, whose real keys and lengths depend on the robot model and the camera configuration. The action vector is selected by controller_configs, a constructor option (door_open.py:21); the clone states no controller action bound, so the package declares no Limit and the fake accepts any non-empty finite numeric vector. timestep_ms is 0 because control_freq is a constructor option (default 25, door_open.py:43); a tick counts one environment step, not a stated physical duration. The upstream reset applies initialization_noise by default (door_open.py:29) and exposes no seed method, so determinism.kind is none and the reset seed is recorded for the class contract only, not used to select a trajectory. No hardware backend, no physical e-stop and no hardware run are claimed; the device is simulated R0 and the runtime's e-stop latch refuses reset and step while the last observation stays readable. MuJoCo, mujoco-py and robosuite were not installed and the upstream environment was never imported or run, so no trajectory was compared with it. Expected warning kept: G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because no Limit is declared on an actuating capability (the class bounds ticks 1..10000 and seed >= 0 are catalogue schema enforced before the driver). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No site-limits.example.json is needed. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json authored_by is the model/run id; reviewed_by stays null); it was checked on the fake backend only.
